tools.name: find_visuals
tools.description: Search the SmartVisuals catalog by keyword. Returns matching Power BI custom visuals with their slug, name, publication status and a reason explaining why each result matched. Use this to discover which visual fits a reporting need (e.g. 'retention cohort', 'radar comparison', 'time series forecast'

tools.name: get_visual
tools.description: Return the full catalog entry for one SmartVisuals Power BI custom visual, including its GUID, data roles (field wells), version, description, use cases, free-tier limits, premium features and diagnostic flags. Use after find_visuals to inspect a specific visual.

tools.name: get_binding_example
tools.description: Return the PBIR (Power BI Report) layout snippet and binding notes for a SmartVisuals visual. The snippet includes the publicCustomVisuals GUID array and a queryState template with placeholder field references for each required data role. Use this when you need to programmatically add a SmartVisuals

tools.name: list_visuals
tools.description: List every visual in the SmartVisuals catalog. Optionally filter by publication status: 'live' (published on Microsoft Marketplace), 'in-review' (submitted, awaiting Marketplace review) or 'coming-soon' (in development). Returns slug, name, shortName and status for each visual.
